preconditions.description: The size of the function domain n is between 1 and 200 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= f[i] <= n for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: Each value in the function f is between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output k is a positive integer between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(f_k(f_k(x)) == f_k(x) for x in range(1, n + 1))
postconditions.description: The function f applied k times is idempotent, meaning f_k(f_k(x)) = f_k(x) for all x in the domain.

postconditions.expression: not any(f_k(f_k(x)) != f_k(x) for x in range(1, n + 1) for k in range(1, return_value))
postconditions.description: For all k less than the output, the function f applied k times is not idempotent.
